title: Kafka Streams admits the session close boundary and publishes one final count
summary: At the grace boundary the parent dropped A at time 8 and emitted a provisional final A at time 3. The merged Streams topology accepted the boundary record and published only A@[0,5] with count two.

change.description: The aggregate accepts a session whose end equals stream time minus grace.

notes: Each comparison uses Kafka Streams, clients, Connect modules and the test driver from its exact pin. Rebuilding all seven test-driver sources independently on the two locked classpaths produced identical driver JARs.
Each deployment checks the JDK fingerprint, ordered artifact digests, caller classes and original class providers. The same compiled caller runs both sides in fresh JVMs.
